title: Le Creuset Espresso mugs
text: Le Creuset Espresso mugs. I purchased these Le Creuset Espresso mugs to make hot chocolate for my grandsons (4 and 7).  They are the perfect size for them.  The other thing I do is make cake mix, put in the mug and bake or microwave it.  Cool and then top with nutella.  It's a fun, small treat.  So... these mugs are SMALL!  They are "espresso mugs" so they are meant to be small.  I have included some pics to help with the sizing.  They are perfect size for my use.  The other thing is that this brand, Le Creuset is exceptionally high quality and you can safely bake, microwave and dishwasher clean. They are relatively heavy for the their size. I had wanted the "black"... but they didn't have enough so I opted for these which are called "truffle."  They are a lovely dark, taupey brown to me.  Please see photos.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I fully expect these to last for years and years.

product_metadata.title: Le Creuset Stoneware Petite Espresso Mug, 3.5-Ounce, Palm
features: Stoneware maintains even temperatures and prevents scorching
Unmatched thermal resistance - safe for freezer, microwave, oven, broiler and dishwasher
Dense stoneware blocks moisture absorption to prevent cracking, crazing and rippling
Impermeable exterior enamel resists scratches and stains and is safe for cutting on with knives
Nearly-nonstick glazed interior easily releases foods for quick cleanup
description: Enjoy just the right amount of espresso with this set of four petite mugs from Le Creuset. Made from white enameled stoneware, this set is durable and the enamel blocks moisture absorption and prevents cracking, crazing and rippling. Designed with you in mind and modeled after Le Creuset's larger coffee mug, it features a simple ridged pattern at the base and a handle for an easy and secure grip. Best of all, this set comes with a five year manufacturer's warranty and is dishwasher safe, making clean up a breeze.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash, Microwave Safe, Hand Wash Only
